name: vilsem-mcp
description: Let Claude author custom Power BI visuals on your live Desktop model: previews on real data, self-review, and commits into PBIP reports.
long_description:
Vilsem connects read-only to the semantic model open in Power BI Desktop on this PC. Claude can run DAX to check the data, render a preview of a custom visual on real values with an automatic critique (overlapping labels, contrast, ordering, empty data), fix its own mistakes, and then add the visual to your PBIP report as a declarative spec drawn by one shared Vilsem renderer. Later you can ask for edits in plain language.

Requirements: Windows, Power BI Desktop, and a report saved as a PBIP project (enhanced PBIR). Local Desktop models only; online Service/Fabric connections are disabled. Vilsem never changes your model and has no telemetry. Start by asking Claude to call get_playbook. Evaluation release: try it on copies of your reports first.
